releases.title: Join Gal for LIVE Guitar Practice!
releases.summary:
Join Gal for LIVE Guitar Practice!

Hey everyone, it’s Gal 🤘
Welcome to a brand new series for Patreon and #Nostr Zappers, where we’ll open the doors to our practice sessions!
I’m excited to kick things off with a live stream guitar practice 🎸 
Since this is Nostr get the link to the live-stream if you zap⚡1000 Sats ( #Fanfares !)

The very first session will be this Saturday (Sep 20) at 19:00 CET. I’ll be rehearsing our set for our upcoming show, digging into the trickier guitar parts as well as running through full songs.

Hope to see as many of you as possible with me there!

Cheers 🤍 ht
